name: Pac Bo
summary: Give Pac Bo a half day from Cao Bang city, about 55 km north on provincial road 203. You walk Coc Bo, where Ho Chi Minh stayed after returning in 1941, and the stream under the hill. Do not pair it with Ban Gioc. The two roads leave town in different directions.
timeNeeded: Half a day from the city, including the drive
getThere: About 55 km north of Cao Bang city on provincial road 203.
heroCaption: The stream at Pac Bo, under the forested hill

notice.title: Not the same afternoon as the falls
notice.body: Pac Bo is about 55 km north. Ban Gioc is more than 80 km east. A plan that puts both on one careless afternoon misses one of them.

body: Pac Bo is the mouth of the spring, at km 0 of the Ho Chi Minh Road. The walk is Coc Bo cave and the Lenin stream under Karl Marx mountain. The relic monograph dates the special-national listing to 10 May 2012 and ties the site to 1941–1945. Vietnam Tourism describes the cave and the river where he fished.

The first photograph is the stream and the valley. It does not show the cave mouth. The second is the inside of Coc Bo. On-site minutes are check on arrival. The monograph’s hillside is reason enough for shoes with a grip. A measured path length was on a provincial feature that was not reloaded, so it stays off this page.
Go in daylight. The fee is check on arrival. No tariff was on the monograph or on vietnam.travel.

gettingThere: The relic monograph places Pac Bo at Truong Ha, Ha Quang, about 55 km north of the city on provincial road 203. A provincial feature indexed on the tourism site said about 52 km. That page was not reloaded. Use 55 km. Minutes on the road are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Cao Bang city
legs.body: North on provincial road 203, about 55 km. Hire a car or a motorbike in the city. A local bus is check on arrival. The half day includes this drive.

legs.heading: From Hanoi
legs.body: Come to Cao Bang city first. Vietnam Tourism puts that ride at about 280 km and about eight hours, and other desks disagree. Pac Bo is a further 55 km the next day, not a stop on the way into town.

closed: No weekly closing day was on the monograph or on Vietnam Tourism. Check the board on arrival.
